nodes.description: Public constant-like cap for the whole collection (100000) used to size the ERC721A constructor.
Public cap on tokens minted per transaction (12), passed as maxBatchSize to ERC721A.
Public limit of dice rolls / mint transactions (8785) enforced in mint.
Private counter of roll operations, exposed through totalRolls().
Public boolean flag gating public minting, toggled by setStatusSales.
Private mapping from dice count (1 or 2) to the wei price of a mint.
Private base URI prefix returned by _baseURI for token metadata.
ERC721A mapping tokenId => TokenOwnership (addr, startTimestamp) using sparse serial ownership.
ERC721A mapping owner => AddressData (balance, numberMinted) packed in uint128 fields.
Ownable private owner address, written only by _setOwner.
External payable mint entry point: checks roll cap, dice count, sales status and exact msg.value, rolls dice then _safeMint.
Private view randomness helper deriving token quantity from keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, seed).
Public view returning the _totalRolls counter.
Public view returning prices[_diceCount] after validating dice count.
External view returning the token ids held by an owner via tokenOfOwnerByIndex enumeration.
onlyOwner setter for the metadata base URI.
onlyOwner toggle of the salesStatus minting gate.
onlyOwner setter of the one-dice and two-dice prices.
Owner/cofounder-only payout splitting the contract balance 50/50 using low-level send calls.
ERC721A internal batch mint writing _addressData/_ownerships and looping over the receiver callback; also stores block.timestamp.
ERC721A private hook that performs an external onERC721Received call on contract recipients.
ERC721A private transfer that validates approval/ownership and rewrites ownership and balance slots.
Internal helper that materialises owner slots up to nextOwnerToExplicitlySet to bound ownerOf loops.
Ownable private setter that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Public view returning the Ownable _owner and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
onlyOwner ownership transfer with zero-address check, delegating to _setOwner.
onlyOwner function setting the owner to address(0) via _setOwner.
Context helper returning msg.sender for all authorization checks and callbacks.
ERC721A internal existence check comparing tokenId against currentIndex.
Internal lookup walking backwards up to maxBatchSize slots of _ownerships to resolve an owner record.
Caller-controlled address used for minting eligibility, dice seed and withdrawal authorization.
Miner-influenced timestamp used as randomness entropy and stored as ownership startTimestamp.
Predictable/manipulable on-chain randomness determining the number of tokens minted.
Low-level Ether transfer via send in withdrawAll with return value checked by require.
External call to a caller-supplied contract during safe mint/transfer, allowing arbitrary code execution.
Recipient address of the minted batch passed to _safeMint.
Number of dice rolled (1 or 2) validated in mint.
Dice count controlling the modulo range of the rolled value.
Seed address derived from msg.sender mixed into the randomness hash.
Local holding the dice result that becomes the mint quantity.
New base URI string written to _baseTokenURI.
New boolean value written to salesStatus.
Price in wei for a single-dice roll, stored at prices[1].
Price in wei for a two-dice roll, stored at prices[2].
Hard-coded cofounder payout address allowed to call withdrawAll.
50% share of the contract balance sent to the cofounder.
Remaining balance sent to msg.sender.
Number of ownership slots to materialise in one call.
Address receiving ownership, checked against address(0).
Address written into the _owner storage slot.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against owner() for the sales gate and is forwarded as the dice seed.
msg.sender is passed as the _seed argument of rollDice, influencing the randomness input.
withdrawAll authorises the payout by comparing msg.sender to owner() or the hard-coded cofounder.
onlyOwner modifier gate evaluates _msgSender() against owner().
onlyOwner modifier gate evaluates _msgSender() against owner().
onlyOwner modifier gate evaluates _msgSender() against owner().
block.timestamp is hashed as entropy inside rollDice, making the roll miner-influenceable.
_safeMint stores uint64(block.timestamp) as the ownership start timestamp for minted tokens.
rollDice derives the mint quantity from keccak256(block.difficulty, block.timestamp, seed).
mint calls rollDice and uses its return value as _count.
mint validates msg.value against getPrice(_diceCount).
mint requires totalRolls() < MAX_ROLLS before proceeding.
mint performs the actual token creation through _safeMint.
mint reads the MAX_ROLLS roll cap from storage.
totalRolls returns the _totalRolls storage counter.
mint increments the _totalRolls counter after a successful roll.
getPrice returns prices[_diceCount] from the prices mapping.
setBaseURI writes the supplied string into _baseTokenURI.
setStatusSales writes the supplied boolean into salesStatus.
setPrices writes prices[1] and prices[2].
withdrawAll executes low-level send transfers of Ether to the cofounder and the caller.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes onERC721Received on the untrusted recipient contract.
_safeMint calls _checkOnERC721Received for every token in the minted batch.
A malicious receiver can re-enter mint through the receiver hook before batch accounting completes.
A malicious receiver callback can re-enter withdrawAll while the balance split is being paid out.
_safeMint increases the recipient balance and numberMinted in _addressData.
_safeMint writes the TokenOwnership record of startTokenId into _ownerships.
ownershipOf scans _ownerships backwards to resolve the current owner.
_setOwnersExplicit resolves missing owner slots using ownershipOf.
transferOwnership delegates the storage write to _setOwner.
renounceOwnership delegates the storage write to _setOwner(address(0)).
_setOwner writes the new owner address into the _owner slot.
owner() reads the _owner storage variable.
_msgSender returns msg.sender to all callers performing authorization checks.
_transfer rewrites _ownerships for the transferred token and the next token slot.
_transfer decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance in _addressData.
